Welcome to this beautifully upgraded single-story home, where modern updates and thoughtful design create the perfect move-in-ready home. Extensively remodeled, this turnkey residence features newer dual pane windows, updated HVAC, stylish laminate and tile flooring, recessed kitchen lighting, remodeled bathrooms, and much more.

The beautifully appointed kitchen showcases real wood cabinetry with convenient pull-out shelving, granite countertops, a spacious pantry, lazy Susan storage, and a suite of stainless steel appliances including a five-burner range with integrated griddle, built-in microwave, ultra-quiet dishwasher with third rack, and a pull-down spray faucet.

The spacious living room offers a cozy fireplace, vaulted ceilings, and ample room for comfortable seating and entertaining. The adjoining dining area flows seamlessly into the living space, creating an open and inviting atmosphere. Sliding glass doors from both the living room and primary bedroom lead to a private patio retreat, perfect for relaxing or enjoying outdoor dining.

All bedrooms are generously sized, while both bathrooms have been completely renovated with updated vanities, sinks, countertops, toilets, fixtures, and beautiful ceramic tile surrounds.

Additional highlights include an interior laundry area with extra storage, a private two-car garage, a driveway accommodating two additional vehicles, and convenient guest street parking.

Residents enjoy an impressive array of community amenities including a pool, spa, tennis courts, secured RV storage, and the added value of water, sewer, and trash services included in the HOA. This exceptional home combines comfort, style, and convenience—an opportunity not to be missed!

This 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers character and a peaceful place to unwind, with strong bones and room to make it your own. The open kitchen flows easily into the family room, creating a relaxed, connected space for everyday living. An outdoor laundry room keeps interior living space open and uncluttered.

Step outside to a flat, private backyard made for slowing down — shaded by fruit trees, including productive lemon trees, with plenty of room to garden, unwind, or simply enjoy the quiet. Two storage sheds and a second detached structure keep the space tidy and functional, while a covered carport comfortably fits two vehicles.

Big-ticket peace of mind comes standard: a roof that's only 3 years young, sewer line work already completed, and solar that will be paid off at closing — so you can settle in without worrying about what's next.

A great fit for a first-time buyer, or anyone looking for a home with character, calm, and room to grow.

results.remarks:
Tucked behind the gates of Ontario’s Parkside community, this two-story townhome offers a private, sun-washed courtyard and a bright interior that feels ready for its next chapter. Mediterranean stucco, a clay-tile roof, and a decorative iron balcony set a warm first impression, while a wrought-iron gate opens onto pavers, an easy outdoor room for a grill, a couple of chairs, and weekend gatherings.

Step inside to an open, freshly painted main floor washed in natural light, with light wood-look flooring, recessed lighting, and a living area that flows straight into the kitchen. Dual windows look toward the courtyard, and the kitchen answers with white cabinetry, granite counters, and a center island with a dual sink that doubles as a breakfast bar. Stainless appliances, a gas range, a pantry alcove, and extra cabinet storage keep the space practical and inviting. A powder room with a pedestal sink sits nearby, and the attached two-car garage opens directly into the home.

Upstairs, everyday living is well thought out. A dedicated laundry room and a landing with built-in cabinetry sit just off the bedrooms. Two secondary rooms offer ceiling fans and generous closets, sharing a full hall bath with a tub and shower. The primary suite is the quiet retreat: a spacious walk-in closet and an en-suite with dual vanities, a glass walk-in shower, and a soaking tub set in an arched, window-lit alcove.

Residents enjoy an oversized community pool, clubhouse, fire pit, playground, picnic areas, and a dog park, with Cucamonga-Guasti Regional Park next door for fishing, pedal boats, and water play. Our homes offer brand-new Whirlpool® stainless steel electric cook top with oven, dish washer and out-side vented microwave. Additionally, there is convenient powder room downstairs for your guests. The upstairs lead to a spacious primary bedroom with two large walk-in closets and a luxurious adjoining bath with cultured marble countertops, dual undermount sinks and a walk-in shower. There is an upstairs laundry room and linen closet for added convenience. The two secondary bedrooms are opposite the primary bedroom. The large hallway bathroom has tub/shower combination, sink with cultured marble countertop. The exterior of the home has water-efficient front landscaping. The energy efficiency of our Energy Star® certified home is complemented by an eco-friendly solar energy system (either lease or purchase required) and dual-pane, low E glass windows.  This helps ensure uninterrupted comfort all year long. Future community amenities include a park, pool, spa, and ball courts. Access to I-15, I-10, and 60 Freeways are easy. You are also close to shopping at Costco® and 99 Ranch Market. The Ontario International Airport and Ontario Mills Mall are a short drive away. Equinox is also located next to the future Grand Park and a short distance from Park View elementary school. Equinox by KB Home is really a great place to live! Photo is rendering of model home. Buyer can lease or purchase solar

results.remarks:
Submit your best offer. Welcome to this beautifully maintained end-unit condo in the highly desirable Ontario Ranch community! Built just five years ago, this charming home offers modern comfort, thoughtful design, and fantastic community amenities.
Enjoy great curb appeal with a private courtyard and a lush grassy area out front, maintained by the HOA, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Inside, you’ll find stylish vinyl plank flooring, neutral décor, and an open-concept layout filled with natural light. The spacious family room features ceiling fans and flows seamlessly into the dining area and open kitchen, complete with a center island, granite countertops, and sliding glass doors leading to the backyard. There is also a conveniently located powder bathroom.
Upstairs, the primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a walk-in closet and an ensuite bathroom featuring dual sinks, a separate soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom with dual sinks, and a convenient upstairs laundry room provide ample space and functionality for everyday living. Ceiling fans are thoughtfully placed throughout the home for added comfort.
Step outside to your wraparound backyard, featuring a low-maintenance patio and artificial turf, ideal for outdoor enjoyment year-round. Additional highlights include a two-car garage and a leased solar system, helping to reduce energy costs.
Residents of this vibrant Ontario Ranch neighborhood enjoy resort-style amenities, including a clubhouse, pool, spa, pickleball and sport courts, gym, fire pit, barbecue and outdoor cooking areas, picnic spaces, playground, dog park, and beautifully maintained grounds.
This move-in ready home offers the perfect blend of style, convenience, and community, don’t miss your opportunity to make it yours!

results.remarks: NEW PRICE. NEW OPPORTUNITY. A PLACE TO LIVE. A LIFESTYLE TO LOVE. Thoughtfully crafted for modern living, 3440 E Santa Clara Lane #2 brings together comfort, style, and the ease of life at New Haven at Ontario Ranch. Inside, 1,048 sq. ft. of well-planned interiors feature 2 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, with an open layout that feels bright & connected. The main level seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. Vinyl plank flooring, recessed lighting, and plantation shutters add warmth, privacy, and timeless character. Crisp white cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample storage give the kitchen a fresh, polished look. Natural light fills the main level, creating a welcoming interior with an easy flow from one space to the next. A powder room, dedicated storage closet, and interior laundry add practicality. The refrigerator and stacked washer and dryer are included. Upstairs, two private bedroom suites offer a peaceful retreat, each with its own modern ensuite bath, while the primary includes a walk-in closet. The private front patio and courtyard extend the home outdoors, perfect for adding favorite plants, settling in with a book, or taking in some fresh air. An attached two-car tandem garage plus a one-car driveway accommodate up to three vehicles, with additional garage storage. Beyond the residence, New Haven makes recreation part of the everyday experience. Take a refreshing swim, challenge friends to pickleball or basketball at Canvas Park, plan an afternoon BBQ, stroll through landscaped greenbelts, let your dog run and play at Paws Park, or settle around a firepit as the day winds down. Residents have access to Canvas Park, Cherry Park, Emerald Park, Sundance Park, Paws Park, and The Resort at Picnic Park, offering pools and spas, playgrounds, sports courts, recreation centers, picnic settings, lawns, BBQ stations, firepit lounges, and dog parks. At The Resort at Picnic Park, approximately six acres invite you to make a day of it with family and lap pools, a spa, splash zone, playground, BBQ pavilion, firepit, clubhouse, and social spaces. Located in Ontario Ranch, the home is close to shopping, dining, schools, major freeways, and Ontario International Airport. Whether you're purchasing your first home, simplifying your lifestyle, or searching for more beyond your front door, 3440 E Santa Clara Lane #2 brings home and neighborhood together beautifully. Come experience New Haven. Come experience the lifestyle.

Welcome to one of the most desirable homes currently available in the highly sought after New Haven master planned community in Ontario Ranch. Built in 2019, this beautifully upgraded 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom home offers 2,275 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space that blends modern style, smart technology, and everyday functionality. The open concept floor plan is designed for the way people live today. The spacious kitchen flows seamlessly into the main living and dining areas, creating the perfect space for entertaining, gathering with family, or enjoying everyday life. Designer finishes include quartz countertops, luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout, and a tankless water heater. One of the most valuable features of this home is the first floor bedroom and full bathroom with a walk in shower, perfect for multigenerational living, overnight guests, or a private home office. Upstairs, you'll find generously sized bedrooms and the convenience of an upstairs laundry room. Step outside to your own private patio, offering a peaceful outdoor retreat without the maintenance of a large yard. Technology is built into this home with a Ring security system, smart thermostat, EV charging capability in the garage, and an energy efficient tankless water heater. It is a home designed to complement Ontario Ranch's nationally recognized smart city infrastructure. Location is where this home truly shines. Directly across the street is New Haven Marketplace and the popular Rodeo X food hall, one of the Inland Empire's premier gathering destinations featuring live entertainment, dining, coffee shops, fitness studios, shopping, and Stater Bros. Market. Residents enjoy resort style amenities including four recreation areas with pools, spas, parks, playgrounds, barbecue areas, a dog park, clubhouse, and year round community events. Complete with an attached two car garage and ample guest parking, this home offers the perfect combination of location, lifestyle, technology, and flexible living spaces. This is more than just a home. It is an opportunity to experience one of Southern California's most desirable master planned communities.

Welcome to 532 East Rosewood Court, a lovingly preserved single-family cottage set behind mature shade trees on one of Ontario's most charming, tree-lined streets in a cherished, historic pocket of the city. Owned and cared for by the same family for generations — this home offers a rare opportunity to own a piece of Ontario's residential history, presented in its original condition and ready for your personal vision.
Inside, hardwood floors and a classic brick fireplace anchor the living room, while charming original architectural details — including a decorative wall niche — add character throughout. Step through the elegant double French doors off the dining room onto the back patio, creating an easy flow for indoor-outdoor living.
The two bedrooms are thoughtfully outfitted with built-in closet space and custom cabinetry, and built-in linen closets are tucked throughout the home for extra storage. The shared bathroom has been tastefully updated with a new shower and its own built-in linen closet. Multiple patio areas and an expansive grassy backyard make the outdoor space perfect for entertaining, gardening, or letting kids and pets play.
With its blend of vintage character, thoughtful built-ins, and a location on one of Ontario's most storied streets, this home is ready to welcome its next chapter. Schedule your private tour today.
